title: Batch A real-data import does not setval() sequences after COPY — enable_paper crashes with HTTP 500
description: scripts/dev_db/batch_a_import_real_data.py imports real production rows into dev DB strategy_pkg / paper_v2 / public.aistock_model_catalog tables but does not setval() the corresponding PostgreSQL sequences after the COPY. Concrete failure: strategy_pkg.package_status_event_event_id_seq stayed at last_value=4 while the imported rows already used event_id up to 154. Codex Phase 3 governance live smoke triggered HTTP 500 on enable_paper because the next nextval() collided with an existing primary-key value, causing UniqueViolation that the legacy code path did not coerce into the proper InvalidStateTransitionError. Codex manually setval()'d the sequence to max(event_id) to unblock the smoke. Root fix: scripts/dev_db/batch_a_import_real_data.py must append a 'SELECT setval(<seq>, COALESCE(MAX(<id>), 1)) FROM <table>' for every IDENTITY/SERIAL column it touches. Also need to extend Batch C synthetic fixture imports if they share the same path.
reproduce_command: psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5433 -d aistock_dev -c "SELECT last_value FROM strategy_pkg.package_status_event_event_id_seq" && curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8012/api/v1/strategy-packages/<pkg_id>/enable-paper
required_verification: Re-run Batch A import on a fresh dev DB
post-import: SELECT pg_sequence_last_value(...) >= max(id) for every covered table
Codex governance live smoke (enable_paper happy + fail-fast paths) returns 200/4xx, no 500
closure_requirements: Sequence sync verified for all imported tables
Optional regression test asserts setval invariant after import

events.note: Phase 3 governance live smoke - first enable_paper probe hit HTTP 500 due to seq behind max(event_id). Manually fixed via SELECT setval() to unblock smoke.

Stage 4 T-PIPE-4.5: scripts/dev_db/batch_a_seq_reset.py introduced as the canonical idempotent sequence-reset helper covering 17 strategy_pkg + paper_v2 + qe_archive tables. backend/tests/dev_db/test_batch_a_seq_hygiene.py adds 11 regression tests (parse_env, dev-target safety, setval emission, error propagation, RESET_TARGETS coverage, render). dw-foundation team should call this helper at the end of batch_a_import_real_data.py main() before the post-import validation block. fix_commit will be set after the Stage 4 commit lands.
